newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce profits boosted by HPP buy.
newsitem.headline: Oce profits boosted by HPP buy.

text.p: Dutch photocopier maker Oce-van der Grinten NV said on Wednesday its strong third quarter growth was largely due to the April acquisition of HPP, the high-performance printing division of Germany's Siemens Nixdorf.
"The strong increase in operating profit was also due to the contribution made by HPP," it said in a statement.
Oce said Q3 sales rose 61 percent to 1.12 billion guilders.
"Disregarding exchange rate effects (+5 percent) and the HPP acquisition (+41 pct), sales would have increased by 15 percent," it said.
HPP sales in the period to end-August were 288 million guilders. Oce said HPP's results were characterised by a lower gross margin and lower operating costs.
Oce paid around 900 million guilders for HPP
Oce posted third quarter net profit of 38.9 million guilders versus 22.7 million in the same period of 1995 and said it expects that growth to continue in the fourth quarter.
